title: Board Policy on Capital Credits: Early Retirement Discount Rate by Time Since Departure and Years of Patronage
content:
# Early Retirement Discount Rate by Time Since Departure and Years of Patronage

**Policy — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital), distribution-margin rows retired under an approved discounted early retirement.**

The early discount rate is set by how long the former member has been gone and how much patronage the credits represent:

- a former member whose last final-billed service account has been final for at least 60 full calendar months and whose account holds fewer than 5 distribution-margin allocation years is discounted at **8.5 percent**;
- one whose last final-billed service account has been final for at least 60 full calendar months and whose account holds at least 15 distribution-margin allocation years is discounted at **6.5 percent**;
- for every other former member this rule sets no rate.

## What the records show

- **Time since departure.** Read from the former member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule records: the final date of the member's last service account in final billed status, counted in full calendar months up to the date the row is booked.
- **Years of patronage.** The number of distribution-margin allocation entries on the capital account, one for each allocation year. Wholesale-supplier pass-through allocations are not counted.

## Rate table

| Full calendar months since the last final date | Distribution-margin allocation years on the account | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or more | 1 to 4 | 8.5 percent |
| 60 or more | 5 to 14 | not set by this rule |
| 60 or more | 15 or more | 6.5 percent |
| fewer than 60 | any number | not set by this rule |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Months since final | Allocation years | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 60 | 4 | 8.5 percent — 60 months is "at least 60", 4 is "fewer than 5" |
| 59 | 4 | not set by this rule — 59 months is short of 60 |
| 60 | 5 | not set by this rule — 5 years is no longer fewer than 5 and not yet 15 |
| 60 | 15 | 6.5 percent — 15 is "at least 15" |
| 60 | 14 | not set by this rule |
| 132 | 22 | 6.5 percent |

Both conditions of a tier must hold together; a long departure alone, or a short or long patronage alone, sets no rate.
